notes.title: 20240908mini-update
notes.notes:
Longevity can now be set by default.
Typhoon frequency can be set by default.

notes.title: 20240905mini-update
notes.notes: The window of the center allows the user to check the status of major research accomplishments.

notes.title: 20240825mini-update
notes.notes:
In the village, the shortcut button for max lvl is no longer displayed in squares that are already reserved for max lvl.
In the village, the LVUP shortcut button is no longer displayed for squares that are currently lvl, under construction, or scheduled to be lvl max if the queue is taken into account.
In the village, the embankment construction shortcut button will no longer appear when a river embankment is being reserved.
In the village, the construction cancel button has been made easier to understand.

notes.title: Official Release！
notes.notes:
Rivalry Warlord Sengoku, which has been available in Early Access for some time, has now been officially released! Thank you very much for your cooperation.
With the official release, we are planning to revise the price to $8.99
However, for the first week after the release (until August 29th in Japan time), the price will be 700 yen, the same as the early release price, to celebrate the release. Please note that the price will be revised to $8.99 after August 30 (Japan time).

notes.title: About the official release
notes.notes:
Notice of Official Release
The official release is scheduled for Thursday, August 22, 2024.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Prices will remain unchanged for one week to celebrate the launch.
The price will be revised one week after the launch.
